title: THREE PENALTIES MISSED. THREE COACHES. ONE MESSI.
description:
Three misses in a row, three coaches in a year, and Messi is the only constant.

Lionel Messi has missed three penalties in a row: two at the World Cup, one at Nashville in August. The first run like that since 2014. Inter Miami have had three head coaches this year, and he is the only constant. Coaches arrive, coaches leave, Messi gives the induction. The club's HR department, basically.

He finished fifth in the Ballon d'Or and skipped the gala. Fifth. Most players would frame it. Instead he stayed in Miami for the Messi Cup, a youth tournament named after himself. Eight Ballon d'Or wins is still the all-time record, so: bad run, great career. Then Miami led Charlotte 3-0 and drew 3-3, and Messi didn't score. Another one for HR.

Is this a blip or a proper slump? Where do you land? The comments are open.
